info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Terminal Operational Actions API
info.description: The Card Terminal Operational Actions API enables businesses to manage various operations related to card terminals in specific banking channels. This API allows users to initiate and execute operational actions such as activating terminals, updating configurations, or troubleshooting issues. Ideal for banking developers and operational teams, this API streamlines terminal management processes and enhances customer transaction experiences. Businesses can leverage this functionality to ensure effective terminal operations and maintain seamless service delivery.

post.summary: Create operational actions for a specific card terminal.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create operational actions for a particular card terminal within a specified channel. Utilize this endpoint to initiate actions that can streamline operations and improve service quality for card terminal management.
